description: HyperColab plugin — project coordination, file ownership, and activity tracking

hooks.command: echo 'A HyperColab plugin is installed. At the start of this session, perform project coordination: 1. Call hm_colab_join to join the project associated with the current Git repository. 2. Call hm_colab_sync to retrieve active sessions, ownership, and recent events. 3. Use the returned brief and sync data to understand what is being worked on and by whom.'

echo 'Before this write operation, check HyperColab ownership: 1. Call hm_colab_check for the file(s) about to be modified. 2. If a path is claimed by another session, coordinate a handoff or change scope. 3. If the path is free, hm_colab_claim it before editing.'

echo 'Spawn a background coordination-writer Agent to record project activity from this turn. Pass it a brief summary (under 200 words) of what files were modified, architectural decisions, test results, and current status. The agent handles hm_colab_update, hm_colab_activity, and hm_colab_finish. Do not call those tools yourself.'
